gaps.sentence: It's not worth ___ over spilt milk.
The witness claims ___ the getaway car parked outside for an hour.
gaps.explanation: 'Claims to have seen' — the perfect infinitive marks an earlier action.

gaps.sentence: He was the first climber ___ the summit without oxygen.
gaps.explanation: After 'the first/last/only + noun' a to-infinitive follows.

gaps.sentence: They don't allow ___ in the museum.
gaps.hint: allow + noun / allow sb to do
gaps.explanation: allow + noun/-ing (no personal object): they don't allow photography. With a person: allow visitors to photograph.

gaps.sentence: I tried ___ the shelf up, but it was too heavy.
gaps.explanation: try + to-infinitive = attempt, make an effort.

gaps.sentence: They're planning ___ the flat before selling it.
gaps.explanation: plan + to-infinitive (plan on + -ing also occurs informally): planning to redecorate.

gaps.sentence: We can't risk ___ the deadline again.
She would rather ___ at home tonight.
gaps.explanation: 'Would rather do' — the bare infinitive follows.
